name: layered-redraw
description: Interview users about visual intent, then redraw reference photos as editable semantic-layer SVG projects.

interface.shortDescription: Redraw photos as editable layered SVG artwork.
interface.longDescription: Turn a reference photo and a short art-direction conversation into a portable SVG project with 5–20 stable semantic layers, deterministic validation, and localized edits.
defaultPrompt: Interview me, then redraw this photo in editable SVG layers.
Open my layered SVG and change only the selected objects.
Validate this SVG project without altering the artwork.
